Nigel Farage to face a record 33 candidates in the Clacton by-election, held 13 August 2026, triggered by his own 7 July 2026 resignation as MP (he is re-standing).

Farage cited investigations into him and press treatment as reasons for resigning. His resignation suspends the parliamentary commissioner for standards (Daniel Greenberg) investigation into an undeclared £5 million donation from Christopher Harborne (first revealed by The Guardian). The £5m payment was also reported to the National Crime Agency by bankers under the anti-money-laundering Suspicious Activity Report scheme.

Boycotting the by-election: Labour, Conservatives, Liberal Democrats, Greens and Restore Britain — leaving a field of minor/independent/satirical candidates against Farage.
